Internal: a model's sample checked and its absent categories pruned

Source: R/models.R
dot-jst_model_prefit.Rd

A predictor dummy-coded in the call with one category stops (S347); the categories the analysis sample lacks are pruned from the model frame, the formula and the registrations (.jst_prune_absent_categories()); a predictor constant in the sample stops; no more cases than coefficients stops (S347). jlm() and jlogistic() each held this block (Session 386, the twin build), differing only in the noun.

Usage

.jst_model_prefit(
  mf,
  data,
  formula,
  dummy_regs,
  expanded_originals,
  auto_cat_regs,
  dummy_coef_names,
  ref_cats,
  auto_ref_cats,
  value_mode_coef,
  sample_info,
  .jst_data_name,
  pipeline_data,
  one_cat_in_call,
  noun
)

Arguments

mf, data, formula

The model frame, the data and the formula.

dummy_regs, expanded_originals, auto_cat_regs, dummy_coef_names, ref_cats, auto_ref_cats

The registrations and their columns.

value_mode_coef

The value-label mode of the coefficient rows.

sample_info, .jst_data_name

The Case Processing counts and the data frame's name.

pipeline_data

The pipeline's data, for the constant-predictor stop.

one_cat_in_call

A one-category predictor set aside, or NULL.

noun

Character(1): "A regression" or "A logistic regression".

Value

list(formula, mf, dummy_regs, auto_cat_regs, dummy_coef_names, ref_cats, auto_ref_cats, all_ref_cats).
